comparison.objective: Place a long DIN rail into two standoff cradles using both arms, rather than remove insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support and simultaneous long-part alignment versus stabilizing a narrow mandrel while striking it and recovering fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies the rail is seated in both cradles; no pose tolerances or complete rubric are supplied. No fracture, coil-retention, or fragment-recovery outcome appears.
comparison.reason: Although both are bimanual and alignment-sensitive, long-part seating tests a different physical ability and outcome.
